title: Video Viewer
content: # **Objective** Play video files directly on the CLO-SET Viewer and upload video clips as attachment. 1. [Requirements](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/10730582382863#h_01J1VSQBX2AJ2EVJ9A8D4XT0AS) 2. [How to](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/10730582382863#h_01J8EVACKYBXB5AE56Q628TTCY) # **Details** ### 1) Requirements * **Compatible File Format** : MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI, FLV, MPEG-2 TS, MPEG-2 PS, MXF, LXF, GXF, 3GP, WebM, MPG, and QuickTime. * Maximum file size up to **200MB**. ### 2) How to ![video viewer.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778624804377) * Upload a Video file in your [Workroom](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697) * On the [Content](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303210570649) page, click on the 'Play' button (▶) to start playing the clip * Clicking on the viewer again will pause the clip. Manage volume and settings the bottom. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778639998489) 1. **Viewer Selector[Thumbnail](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191375129):** First frame of the uploaded video file 2. **Content Info[Thumbnail](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191375129)**: Expand the Content Info tab to change the Thumbnail to be displayed on Workroom View 3. **Video Viewer Settings** * Play/Pause * Volume * Quality * Speed * Picture-in-picture mode * Full Screen 4. **Attachment** : Attach a video file to the uploaded Content. Same [requirements](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/10730582382863#h_01J1VSQBX2AJ2EVJ9A8D4XT0AS) apply for file compatibility.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide users with guidelines for playing video files directly on the CLO-SET Viewer and uploading video clips as attachments, including requirements and step-by-step instructions.

title: Permission Approval
content: # **Objective** Activate the Permission Approval system for advanced security of your Group & Assets 1. [What is Permission Approval?](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/11866755807887#h_01JEZKN6PS4S2A2SET8CM0GAMS) 2. [Activate Permission Approval](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/11866755807887#h_01JK5E8WM72NX994MRHBYN9SPQ) 3. [Inviting Users](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/11866755807887#h_01JK5EP2YEQ3K57G701VKG4RAN) 4. [Approve/Reject Permission](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/11866755807887#01JK5GFJY9GN2ZYH4FQ5DTZY13) 5. Console > User History > Permission Approval # **Details** ### 1) What is Permission Approval? * Permission Approval is an optional feature that allows Group Admin/Group Operators to review & confirm the users being invited before they gain access to the Group. * It allows managers to fully own the invitations being made to the Group, for advanced security and control over subscription fees. * Please note: activating the option may hinder new invitees from gaining instant access to the Group. ### 2) Activate Permission Approval #### Permission: Group Admin ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778118157209)/ Group Operator * To activate the Permission Approval for your Group, visit Console > Settings > Group Settings * Click the Toggle to activate, and hit 'OK' on the pop-up modal * Note: Permission Approval is turned **off** as default | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778162619417) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778118508953) ---|---|--- ### 3) Inviting Users * When Permission Approval option is activated, status of the new member will be displayed as below. * **Pending** : indicates that the invitee has not created a CLO-SET account yet * **Pre-****approval** : indicates that the Group Admin/Operator has not approved the permission yet * When a new user is invited, Group Admin/Operator will receive a notification email to [take action](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/11866755807887#01JK5GFJY9GN2ZYH4FQ5DTZY13) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778134012313) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778179015065) * Once Group Admin/Operator approves the new member, they will receive an email notification, along with an access link ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778134379545) ### 4) Approve/Reject Users #### Permission: Group Admin ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778118157209)/ Group Operator * Whenever a new member is invited to the Group, Group Admin/Operator will receive an email to approve the new member. Click 'Go to Use Administration' to proceed. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778179015065) * In Console > Permission Approval > Pending Users tab, click 'Approve' or 'Reject' * Note: once approved, the new member will receive an email notification ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778134803737) ### 5) Console > User History > Permission Approval * On the Console > User History > Permission Approval tab, you can find the full list of approved/pending/rejected users **[All User Status]** Displays the full list of users invited to the Group (including approved, pending, removed) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778134995353) * * **Status** of the accounts are displayed as one of the two: * Active: User accepted with access * Removed: User removed from Group * Clicking on the active user's account email to view [Permission Management](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303209418649) info for the selected account **[Pending Users]** Displays the list of requests that are pending/rejected ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778180105369) * **Status** of the accounts are displayed as one of the four below: **Status** | **Action/Next Step** | **Details** ---|---|--- Pending | Approve / Reject | Pending request. Group Admin/Operator can approve or reject the request. Approved | Request approved, but the end user is not registered in CLO-SET yet. Rejected | Reapprove | Request rejected. Group Admin/Operator can re-approve the request. * Once the new member is approved, the user will be deleted from the 'pending users' tab (but continue to display on the 'all user status' tab) * If the same user has been invited multiple times, approving the user on any 1 of the rows will automatically approve all requests
content_description: This web page aims to guide Group Admins and Operators in activating the Permission Approval system to enhance security and control over group member access and subscriptions.

title: Web Tech Pack ▶ Overview
content: #### Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778236349849) Admin ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778176661273) Collaborator ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778176800537) Editor ### # **Objective** ![web tech pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778220879897) | CLO-SET Web Tech Pack integrates your everyday tech pack with 3D Contents. Let us bring all the data from your 3D file into an auto-generated Tech Pack. Enjoy a tech pack that is always up-to-date. ---|--- 'Overview' allows you to check the overall info of the 3D Content & manage the production schedule ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 10.14.56 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778177241625) 1. Summary * Which fields are editable? 2. Schedule 3. Requirement & Permission 4. [WTP General Guide](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168383385) ### 1) Summary Information on the Summary tab is synched with the Style info tab on your Content page, including the [Custom Information Fields](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239598617) Manage and edit details, and create additional fields by clicking 'ADD INFORMATION' button. *The additional information tab will not be reflected back on the Content Page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778177355417) | ► | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778237535001) ---|---|--- * #### Which Fields are Editable? * Content Name * Company / Brand / Season / Line / Workroom * Workflow * Creator/Created Date * Thumbnail * Tags * Category * Description * [Custom Information Fields](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239598617) ### 2) Schedule Add Schedule and Meeting links for each style to track the production schedule & timeline. ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 10.48.39 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778199619225) | | ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 10.48.52 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778237891225) ---|---|--- 1. Create Schedule and timeline for each phase 2. content_description: This web page provides essential information and guidelines for managing and utilizing the CLO-SET Web Tech Pack, ensuring users can effectively integrate and update their 3D content with auto-generated tech packs.

title: Billing & Payment Email Notification
content: # **Objective** Understand the types of email notification you receive from CLO-SET regarding payment and plan. 1. Who receives the updates? 2. Payment/Invoice * Complete * Failed / Cancelled 3. New user (additional charges) 4. Plan change * Upgrade * Downgrade / Settled Addition Credit # **Details** ### 1) Who receives the updates? * **Group Admin** and **Group Operators** will be notified of the updates on payment/plan/charges of the Group. Group Admin is the owner account of the Group and cannot be changed. However, you may add/edit Group Operators on[ Console - Settings - Group Settings](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303195393049). * Learn more about CLO-SET[ Permission](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537) * Please note that payment/plan related notifications cannot be turned off. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778680367513) ### 2) Payment/Invoice * ### Complete * When the Group initiates or renews the plan and the payment has been complete successfully, you will receive below notification. #### | #### ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778743297177) | 1. **Invoice/Charges** * List the invoice and details including the invoice number, issued date, and item details 2. **Carryover Balance (if applicable)** * If your Group has addition/deduction credits from the previous measurement, it will be applied to your payment. Learn more from [billing guideline](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191886361). 3. **Payment Total** * Total amount paid by the Group on the noted date. ---|---|--- * ### Failed / Cancelled * You will receive a notification if a payment attempt fails. * CLO-SET offers a **5-day grace period** with 3 automatic payment retries. Your subscription will remain active during this time. If payment is completed within the grace period, your subscription and billing cycle continue as usual; otherwise, your subscription will be cancelled. * Once the grace period is over, your card payment will be cancelled along with your subscription. ### 3) New User (Additional Charges) * When there is an update on your Group member list, it will be reflected on your [Billing History](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257). You will be notified of such updates via email. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778743551257) ### 3) Plan Change * When there is an update on your subscription or plan, you will receive an email notification. * ### Upgrade * When you upgrade your plan from Standard to Premium, changes will be made instantly. The unused amounts will be refunded in the form of credit to be used on your upgrade payment. * You will receive a notification detailing the new plan and paid amount as displayed here. * ### Downgrade / Settled Addition Credit * When you downgrade your plan, you will receive email notification. Please note that the downgrade will take place after your current measurement period is over. * If your group has addition credit due to adding more users within the previous measurement cycle, you will be charged for the addition credit at the end of your subscription. Once this amount is paid, your Group will be downgraded to the Free plan.
content_description: This web page aims to clarify the types of email notifications sent by CLO-SET regarding payment statuses, plan changes, and user updates for Group Admins and Operators.

title: Content Upload
content: # **Objective** Upload your files to CLO-SET to start collaborating. 1. Upload in Workroom or Company Library * Create New Workroom * Upload File(s) * Upload Turntable Images * Create Blank Content 2. Drag & Drop to Upload 3. Direct Upload from CLO3D 4. Content Type & ID 5. Troubleshooting # **Details** ### 1) Upload in Workroom 1\. To upload Content(s), go to the [Workroom](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697) or [Company Library.](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191826841) *Uploading can only be done in Workroom or Company Library. 2\. Click '**\+ NEW** ' button at the top left corner. Select upload option from the drop-down list. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778843312025) * #### **Create New Workroom** * Create a child-workroom (a sub-folder within your Workroom) * #### **Upload File(s)** * Upload single or multiple files to your Workroom/Company Library. Find the list of **[supported file formats](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303203188121)** in CLO-SET [3D Viewer](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153968537). You can upload other file types, but may not be able to preview the file in 3D Viewer. * Select the file(s) to upload, and confirm the list and options. Click 'Upload' | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778812386201) | 1. 1. **File Information** * Extension and file type icon * File name * File size 2. #### **Do not notify Admins & Collaborators** * On: notification NOT sent * Off: notification sent 3. #### **Auto-Naming** * On: automatically assign Content Name as '_File Name_User ID_date_number'_ * Off: use original file name ---|---|--- * * You may exit the Workroom page once the uploading task is initiated. You may NOT cancel the upload once you see the upload progress bar at the bottom-right corner.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778781190041) * #### **Upload Turntable Images** * Select the Content Type. Which Content Type is the original file of this turntable image? * Select the list of files, and enter Colorway Name | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778804166041) | 1. Upload Turntable Images * Unzip Render Turntable files from CLO or CLO-SET, and select the list of images for each Colorway. 2. Insert name of Colorway 3. Select Upload options * Do not notify Admins & Collaborators * Auto-Naming ---|---|--- * * Once uploaded, review the file in Turntable format per Colorway. * #### **Create Blank Content** * Create a 'Blank Content', or a placeholder for your team to upload specific files. * Select the [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) of the file to be uploaded. ### 2) Drag & Drop to Upload ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778804429849) * Drag & Drop File(s) to the Workroom to upload. * Can ONLY upload to the Workroom you are in. To upload the files into the Child Workroom, please first enter the Child Workroom. * Upload options (Do not notify collaborators, Auto-Naming) will follow your last saved option. Default setting is 'Off'. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778827961881) ### 3) Direct Upload from CLO3D * Learn how to **[upload your files directly from CLO3D software to CLO-SET.](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303203672473)** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778815742233) ### 4) Content Type & ID * Learn the classification of [Content Types](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) and the naming convention of [Content ID](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) in CLO-SET. ![Table \(1\) copy.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778815871385) ### 5) Troubleshooting * Please check your **permission**. Users without upload permission will NOT be able to use the drag & drop upload feature. * Permissions: Admin, Collaborator, Editor, Viewer (enable upload) can upload files. * If ANY of your **file names** include special characters, please remove them. * If ANY of your **file size** exceeds 1GB, uploading is not possible. ![스크린샷 2024-02-16 오후 2.49 1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778845198105) ![스크린샷 2024-02-19 오전 9.37 1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778816280729) *If any of your files include unsupported special characters or exceed the file size limit, upload action will be cancelled. * For further issues, please [submit a ticket](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new) with the Workroom URL.
content_description: Upload your files to CLO-SET to initiate collaboration and streamline your workflow with easy drag-and-drop features and direct uploads from CLO3D.

title: Search Contents
content: # **📝 List of Contents** 📍Learn how to search your files in CLO-SET, fast and easy. * Search Tab * In Workroom * In Company / Brand / Line / Season **• Search Tab** --- #### 🔎 Search Tab allows users to locate all the Content(s) they have access to within the Group * Access the Search tab from the dashboard. Click the 'Search' icon on the far left. * Type in keyword or upload images to start the search. Utilize filters to narrow the search results. | ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.10.54 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778290959897) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778297815961) ---|---|--- * **Keyword search** : Search using the Content Name, Creator, or Content ID * **[Image search](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303160683161): **Search using image files, to find similar Contents | ![CLO-SET_Default_Final_Butter.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778291422873) | ► | ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 10.05.37 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778305402393) ---|---|---|--- * **Filter Results:** Narrow the search scope with the filters. If you have not yet, learn how to [input data & labels](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185603609) to each Content * [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) * [Space](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303176120217) * [Workflow](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185603609) * [Category](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185603609) **• In Workroom** --- #### 🔎 Searching in Workroom will display all matching results within the Workroom ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778276939033) * Enter the desired Workroom to start * From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select the scope of search * Contents of Current Room: search the Contents within the current level Workroom only * Contents Including Child Rooms: search the contents from the current Workroom and all its child Workrooms. * Workrooms: search the Child Workrooms within the current Workroom * Type in the keyword. Search results display all matching results within the designated scope * Currently, CLO-SET does not support placeholders when searching **• In Company / Brand / Line / Season** --- #### 🔎 Search for Workrooms or Contents within a specific space * From 'Search For' drop-down, select the search level (Content / Brand / Workroom / Assortment) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778298566937) * Type in the keyword and hit enter. Search results display matching results within the space * When you search for a Workroom/Assortment within a specific Space (Company, Brand, or Line), ALL associated Workrooms/Assortments within that Space will be displayed ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778305861273)
content_description: Discover how to quickly and efficiently search for files in CLO-SET using various methods, including keyword and image searches, within different scopes like Workroom, Company, Brand, Line, and Season.

Visit [HERE](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261750460569) * Email address already in use ![Sign Box \(2\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778078058393) * * if your email address is already in use, please use a different email address to sign up. * OR,[ find the password](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/9026105112591) for your existing account. #### #### #### **4) Using CLO & Marvelous Designer** **[Important]** Starting from the **2024.0 version** of **CLO Individual** and **Marvelous Designer Personal license** , you can start using your CLO-SET account to access CLO and Marvelous Designer * **Before** 2024.0 Release ([For Individual/Personal Users](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261697330329)) * To start using **[CLO](https://www.clo3d.com/)** and **[Marvelous Designer](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/)** , please create an account on the website. We recommend using the same email address as you did in CLO-SET, for a smoother account merging process * To access CLO and Marvelous Designer (before 2024.0 version), please use your User ID and Password for each service. * MD 2024.0 release scheduled in Late February * CLO 2024.0 release scheduled mid-March * **After** 2024.0 Release (For Individual/Personal Users) * Start using CLO-SET account to access CLO and Marvelous Designer software. * Your accounts in CLO, Marvelous Designer, and CLO-SET will automatically be merged based on the email address registered with your account. * Learn more on the Merged Account (CLO-SET account) [HERE](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261751126937). For more instructions on**[CLO](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261729030937) **and **[Marvelous Designer](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261697989529)** use, please follow the hyperlink.
content_description: Create a CLO-SET account to unlock access to all CLO Virtual Fashion services and streamline your experience with CLO and Marvelous Designer.

title: Design File Management
content: # **📝 List of Contents** 📍 Learn how to setup CLO-SET Group to effectively manage project-based design files. For instructions on how to manage shared component files (block patterns, fabric, trims), visit [**HERE**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303154146201). * Setup Group Structure * Setup Workroom Structure * Upload Content(s) * Invite Team # **📓 Details** **• Setup Group Structure[(Instruction Guide)](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776315217433)** --- * Once you sign up, a new [**Group**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985) will be created for you (ex. A's Group) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776315434905) * In CLO-SET, a 'folder' for uploading the files is called [**Workroom**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697) * Please note: Uploading can ONLY be done on **Workroom** level * Take a moment to reflect how you'd like to setup the structure. We recommend reflecting on how your organization chart is setup. * Don't worry, you can always [copy](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303256878105) or [move](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303167509913) Contents and Spaces, or [copy the space structure](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171480345) as needed * EX) Group Structure in CLO-SET ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776347402009) * * EX) Organization Chart in CLO-SET View ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776331809433) * When you're ready, start customizing & expanding your Group structure. To view the space setup, click 'Browse'. To create a new space, click the '+' icon at the top. | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776358602137) | | | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776332621209) ---|---|---|--- **• Setup Workroom Structure** --- * Again, a 'folder' for uploading the files is called [**Workroom**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697) in CLO-SET. * Start creating Workrooms per your needs. Click 'Browse' > Select a Season space > click the '+' button on the top to create a new Workroom. * To rename, double-click on the Workroom Name. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776348308249) **• Upload Content(s)** --- * Once you are done setting up the Structure, start uploading the asset(s) in Workroom or Company Library * Enter the Workroom/Company Library, and click '+New' at the top-left corner * OR, simply drag & drop your asset(s) to the Workroom/Company Library * **Bulk uploading** is supported using above options ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776301470105) **• Invite Team**(optional) --- * Once the Space setup is complete, invite your team members to start the collaboration * Refer to the **[Group Setup Instruction PDF](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776315217433)** for more details **[![Screenshot 2024-01-16 at 2.27.55 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776317353369)](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776315217433)**[![Screenshot 2024-01-16 at 2.28.05 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776317585049)](%20https://clo-set.zendesk.com/guide-media/01HKPR4QHVGJZB32G856JVVMJZ)
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on setting up the CLO-SET Group for efficient management of project-based design files, including group and workroom structures, content uploads, and team invitations.

title: Create Space
content: # **Objective** CLO-SET provides a tailored Space structure tailored for Fashion industry. Start adding new Spaces to build a unique structure that meets your Company's needs. 1. CLO-SET Space Hierarchy 2. Creating each Space # **Details** ### 1) CLO-SET Space Hierarchy CLO-SET Group consists of Spaces from Company all the way to Workroom & Assortment. Workroom is where you can directly upload your Contents and Assets. You may also manage permission by Space. Learn more [HERE](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537). ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 1.47.26 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778728250393) ### 2) Creating each Space **** **Creating Company** Go to 'Companies' and click ![mceclip5.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778744034841) icon to create the Company. You can select the Company picture, color and name. Click 'Confirm' to create the Company. **Creating Brand** Go to 'Brands' and click ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778728655129) icon to create the Brand. You can select the Brand picture, color and name. Click 'Confirm' to create the Brand. **Creating Season** Once you enter into the specific Brand page, click ![mceclip3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778744524057) icon to create the Season. You can type the name of the Season and click 'Confirm' to create the Season. **Creating Workroom/Assortment** Once you enter into the specific Season page, click ![mceclip4.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778728958617) icon to create the Workroom or Assortment. You can type the name of the Workroom/Assortment and click 'Confirm' to create the Space. **Creating Sub-workroom** You can create multiple sub-workrooms under Workroom. Once you enter into the specific Workroom page, click ![mceclip4.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778728958617) icon and click 'Confirm' to create the sub-workroom.
content_description: CLO-SET empowers fashion companies to effortlessly create and customize a structured hierarchy of Spaces, from Company to Workroom, tailored to their unique operational needs.

title: Linked Contents (Parent-Child Contents)
content: #### Permission: ALL (applicable to all Contents you have download/upload access to) # **Objective** With this update, you can now link the Contents when uploading new files from CLO. Create the Parent-Child relationship between old and new seasons OR between block files and final output to better track and manage your assets. ![linkfromclo.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778390531097) 1. [How To](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/8737455380879#h_01HKC8NSJMKEA2BNCCV3VY44BB) 2. [Requirements](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/8737455380879#h_01HKCA5BCE4VDBKJYE1WMK8F9T) # **Details** ### 1) How To To use this feature, you must first setup CLO-SET Library in CLO 3D. Find instructions [HERE](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191662617). * First, download a file from your CLO-SET Library in CLO. When setting up the Link between Contents, this original file will work as the**'Parent Content'** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778375604121) * Make design edits in CLO3D (ex. create a new Colorway or change fabric/material used) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778391024153) * Once the design edit is complete, upload it as a new Content with 'Upload to CLO-SET' option. You can also select Render/Tech Pack via CLO-SET. * Please note that 'Linked Contents' feature is not compatible when uploading a new Version. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778391314329) * Turn on the 'Linked Content' option to create the Parent-Child relationship. 1. Select the Group to upload the new Content. Please note that Contents in different Groups can not be 'Linked' as a Parent-Child. 2. Turn on 'Linked Content' button. 3. Select the Workroom to upload the new Content. Selecting an existing Content is disabled when the 'Linked Content' option is on. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778391631769) * Once uploaded, you can click on 'Linked Contents' to view the Parent/Child Contents. in Content Page | From **'Child Content'** | From **'Parent Content'** ---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778391794841) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778376539673) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778376740505) ### 2) Requirements 1\. Rules for identifying 'Original Content' * The 'Original Content' is always the **first file** you open in CLO3D. * If you used multiple files from CLO-SET Library to create the new Content, only the very first file added would be linked as the Original Content. * If you started with a non-CLO-SET file and added files from CLO-SET library, the latter would **not** be linked as the Original Content. 2\. Rules for Parent-Child relationship * Both of the Parent & Child Contents **MUST** be in the same CLO-SET Group to utilize the 'Linked Content' feature.
content_description: This web page provides guidance on creating Parent-Child relationships between uploaded files in CLO, enabling better asset tracking and management through linked content functionality.

title: Content Version Upload
content: # **Objective** You can upload a single file or turntable image as an uploaded version of a Content in Content page. # **Details** 1. Version Upload 2. Thumbnail Change 3. Version Rename 4. Version Deletion ### 1) Version Upload 1\. On the content page, click ![blobid0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778870662041) to upload newer versions. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778876309785) >2\. Select the file format you wish to upload. Also, you may choose NOT to notify other collaborators on the new version upload. ('Do not notify collaborator'). ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778876510105) #### ### 2) Thumbnail Change Select the file, and click 'Upload'. Once you upload the new version, CLO-SET will **automatically** update the content's thumbnail. If you wish to **keep the original thumbnail from earlier versions** , please turn on the 'Keep the current thumbnail' button. ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778898861465) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778907835417) ---|--- *The blue tab on your Version file indicates that there is Annotation on this content. *The 'Public' sign indicates that this content has been published to 'Embed Viewer' ### 3) Version Rename * From the Content page, hover over the Version you'd like to rename. * Click on •••, and then click 'Rename'. Type in the new Version name, and click 'Confirm'. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778871785369) | ► | ![Screenshot 2023-10-10 at 4.33.42 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778899408409) ---|---|--- *Please note that updating the Version name will **NOT **update the Content Name. Double-click on the Content Name to edit. ### 3.1) Where are Version Names used? Changing the Version name will auto-update the fields below. ![Screenshot 2023-10-10 at 4.47.09 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778899536153) | ![Screenshot 2023-10-10 at 4.48.24 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778877737241) ---|--- * Downloaded file name * Comment, Annotation, Attachment, Colorway tab * WTP - Comment, Version update * File name in CLO (if updated the latest Version) ### 4)Version Deletion ![Screenshot 2023-10-10 at 5.34.51 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778893998617) 1\. You may delete a single version of the content, keeping all other versions live. To delete a specific version, click the ••• button next to it, and click 'Delete'. 2\. Once you delete a specific version, it will not be shown under the Versions list. To view all versions including the deleted ones, click on 'View all histories' on the top right corner. 3\. Please note that the deleted versions CANNOT be restored. Please be cautious when deleting a version with annotations, comments, or attachments.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for uploading, managing, and deleting content versions, including options for thumbnail updates and version renaming.
